raw_market.question: 49ers vs. Seahawks
raw_market.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between 49ers and Seahawks, scheduled for October 11 at 4:25PM ET:
This market will resolve to "49ers" if 49ers win the game.
This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if Seahawks win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
